content.short: A non-custodial DeFi protocol and crypto-token marketplace that allows users to swap, borrow, lend, save and seamlessly perform yield farming.
content.description:
Surehive is changing the game by creating a non-custodial DeFi protocol and crypto-token marketplace implemented on the Cardano blockchain network that allows users to swap, borrow, lend, save and seamlessly perform yield farming.

Surehive is built on the premise of flexibility to liquidity providers through Customizable Liquidity Allocation (CLA) and Constant Ellipse Automated Market Makers (CEAMMs) to improve capital efficiency and reduce slippage on the Cardano network.
